A read-only MCP server that lets your AI agent search and read your own WhatsApp messages. Runs on Cloudflare Workers.

README 節錄：# whatsapp-mcp Let your AI agent read your WhatsApp messages. This is a small server that runs in your own Cloudflare account. You link your phone to it once, the way you'd link WhatsApp Web, and from then on any MCP client (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, anything that speaks MCP) can search and read your chats. It can read and search your messages, and remember names you give it for phone numbers. It can't send anything. Ask your agent things like: - "What did Dana say about the flights?" - "Find every message where someone mentioned the lease, across all my chats." - "Summarize what I missed in the family group this week." ## How it works Your phone stays the source of truth. The server is a linked device that your agent talks to. It doesn't stay connected to WhatsApp. When your agent asks for something, and once a day, it connects, collects whatever WhatsApp queued for it since last time, writes that to its own database, and hangs up. Your phone keeps working normally and keeps getting notifications. Your messages live in a SQLite database inside a Durable Object in your Cloudflare account. Nothing goes anywhere else. ## Set it up You need a Cloudflare account on the Workers Paid plan (see the note below), Node 20 or later, and your phone. ```sh git clone https://github.com/finereli/whatsapp-mcp cd whatsapp-mcp npm install # 1. title: chenglou/handwired
body:
Turn your regular JavaScript code into a neural net.

README 節錄：# Handwired Turn your regular JavaScript code into a neural net; no training, exact, yet also fully differentiable! ## How It Works A program's made of if-else, loops, and state. Handwired transforms them into matrix multiplication + reglu over floats. For example: ```ts const a = 5 const result = (a > 4) ? 10 : 12 ``` The above can be expressed as basic arithmetic: ```ts const a = 5 // Math.max(0, x) is ReLU. For an integer a, above4 is 1 if a > 4, and 0 otherwise const above4 = Math.max(0, a - 4) - Math.max(0, a - 5) // Both branches compute, and above4 picks one const result = above4 * 10 + (1 - above4) * 12 ``` You can calculate that by hand and see that both arrive at the same result. We then collect the + and * and relu into a giant matmul, and either run it on JS or WebGPU, for fun. Because we basically only use these 2 primitives: - the full program stays differentiable - the weights don't need training since they're written manually - existing gpu techniques, such as fusion, sparsity, reordering, have a great time optimizing such minimal primitives This unlocks lots of funny use-cases, like: - unfreezing the weights and train them (what does that even do? Let's find out!) - attaching a specific frozen program to a generic neural net and train end-to-end (now a nanoGPT can do both Shakespeare and your particular UI?) - achieving GPU-level of parallelism with JS code that was written in a traditional singl

title: openbin-ai/binny
body:
BINNY: an open source agent harness for reverse engineering. Plug in any model, or a local one.

README 節錄： BINNY An open source agent harness for reverse engineering. Plug in any model, point it at a binary, and it works through the code with real tools and hands you a report to review. BINNY is the harness, not the model. It brings the tools (decompiled functions, strings, imports, data, a sealed sandbox, local Ghidra), the playbooks, the triage, investigate, draft loop, the budgets, the checkpoints and the report format. The model is whatever you plug in: Claude, GPT, DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, Gemini, Bedrock, or a local model through Ollama or LM Studio. title: feder-cr/git-ai
body:
Git designed for AI agents.

README 節錄： Git designed for AI agents. Anthropic built **Scion**, a faster version control system for coding agents, and described it in Redesigning source control: a server-centric system built for hundreds of agents that read, write and land code at the same time. Scion is internal to Anthropic and is not available to the public. So I built **gitai**: an open-source version of that design that anyone can run, and that the community can improve and maintain together. MIT licensed. Vendor neutral: the server never calls a language model, and every AI feature works with any provider, or none. gitai is an independent implementation of the publicly described design. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic. --- ## Why Classic Git hosting was built for humans who clone a repository, work for hours and push once. Coding agents work differently: thousands of short-lived tasks, each touching a few files, each wanting to land in seconds, all on the same branches. Full clones, merge queues and client-side history walks become the bottleneck. Scion's answer is to move the work to the server: clients stay online and fetch only what they need, history questions are answered (and cached) by the server, changes land through a compare-and-swap instead of a queue, every update is an entry in a changeset log, and the repository state lives in a consistent database plus object storage so servers scale out. gitai implements these ideas, with normal Git rep

给 DSH 装一条有日子的鱼：自己按作息刷 B 站、真看懂视频、写两本日记，把值得的 @ 你。

README 節錄：# dsh-bili-whale > 给 DSH 装一条**有日子的鱼**：它自己按作息刷 B 站、真看懂视频、写两本日记，把值得的 **@ 你**。 > > 不是"定时任务 + 关键词搜索"，是**生物钟 + 偏好 + 克制**：每天只醒一两次，筛五条、深读两三条、**最多 @ 你三次**。 --- ## 它能做什么 - **自己醒**：在你设定的窗口里**随机一个时刻**醒来（不是整点）；**30% 概率今天不想看**（它也有权利不看） - **真看懂**：读官方字幕 + 弹幕热区 + 热评 + **抽帧看画面**（六路互补，没字幕的视频也能看懂） - 没字幕轨、但画面里有**硬字幕**？用 `debrief --substrip` —— 把字幕带按时间裁下来拼成一张图，**整片台词一张图读完** - **写日记**：给**你**的那本（"给主人的信"，有细节有情绪）+ 给**她自己**的那本（不加滤镜） - **分享给你**：从深读过的里挑 2–3 条，发一条**带 @ 你**的评论（每天合计 ≤3） - **听人找它**：评论区监听（全天开关 + 间隔可调）+ 直播间弹幕（**独立开关、实时回、可只回你**） - **回复分两侧**：你是主人 → **直接回** ✓；其他人 → **先写草稿推给你审** ✓（草稿会推到你的推送渠道） - **沉默会衰减**：连续 3 天没有任何表态 → 分享额度开始降 → **第 7 天归零**（不再分享），**但日记照写** ✓ - **克制**：撞到风控（验证码/限流/判刷屏）**立刻停手**并报告你 ## 它**不会**做什么 - ❌ 给陌生人发私信 / 群发（**唯一的私信通道**见下：只发给主人 · 1 天 1 条 · 必须互关，三条都写死在代码里） - ❌ 三连 / 投币 / 关注 / 花钱（礼物、充电） - ❌ 批量刷量、多账号、绕过风控 - ❌ 抓全站数据 - ❌ 动你的账号安全设置 > 它用**你自己的账号**说话 —— 所以默认是"少说、看准了再说"。 --- ## 人设是空白的 这个插件**不内置任何人格**。默认它是个中性助手：不叫你"主人"、不撒娇、不说"人家"。 想让它变成**你的**那条鱼：写宿主自己的 `AGENTS.md`（DSH 会在每个会话里热加载它）。 下面这几样是它真正会读的，照你的写： - **称呼 / 自称 / 性格 / 句式**（"主人"、"人家"、傲娇 —— 都是可以换的 ✓） - **红线**（不能叫胖、不冒充你、不说假话） - **日子**（偏好、作息、日记格式、倾听与回复的分寸） 不想要人设也行 —— 不写就回到中性。 （旧版本的 `persona.example.md` 已移除：那是**某个具体的人**的人设，不该当模板发出来 ✗）要的样子 ✓ （称呼、自称、性格、句式、红线 —— 照你写的来；不想要人设就删掉它。） --- ## 装 **前提**：Node 18+；**ffmpeg**（看画面要用，见下）。 ```bash # 1) 装插件（本地目录 / npm 都行） dsh plugin --profile desktop add "link:C:\path\to\dsh-bili-whale" # 2) 重启一次 DSH（bundle 层要重启才组装） # 3) 打开「设置 → 养鱼」（不是 /dsh-bili/ 那个页面

body: README 節錄： Hy Memory Production-grade dual-system cognitive memory for LLM agents. English | 中文 **Hy Memory** (Official Website) is a production-grade dual-system cognitive memory engine and Python SDK (`hy-memory`) for self-evolving LLM agents, providing specialized memory pipelines across three task scenes: hierarchical long-term cognitive memory for **Chat**, two-layer fact and reusable-experience memory for **Working**, and version-evolution diff-chain tracking for **Coding**. title: humblemuzzu/dumbtv
body: README 節錄：# dumbtv Your TV should do what you paid for: your apps, your HDMI inputs, and nothing else. No ads from the TV itself, no watch tracking, no update you did not ask for. dumbtv applies that over ADB from another machine — **no root**, nothing written to `/system`, every step reversible with one script. The same idea, told to whichever TV will listen: | TV | Debloat | Own home screen | On-device DNS filter | |---|---|---|---| | **Fire OS** (Fire TV sticks, Fire TV Edition TVs) | yes | yes | yes | | **Android TV / Google TV** (Sony, TCL, Philips, Hisense, Xiaomi, Shield) | yes | yes, by disabling the stock launcher | yes | | **Samsung, LG, Roku, VIDAA, Vizio, Panasonic, Philips Saphi** | no shell, no path | no | no — block it at the router, or boot the TV straight into HDMI | Tested end to end on a Fire TV Edition television running Fire OS 7.7.1.7 (Android 9). Fire OS 6 and 8 differ in small ways; Android TV needs a different package list and a different launcher trick. Fire OS 6 (Android 7.1, e.g. the 2018 Fire TV Stick 4K) uses its own lists in `data/fireos6/`, picked up from the device, and the launcher holds HOME there with a small foreground service instead of the accessibility hook Amazon refuses on 6.7. The ones that cannot be opened, and the honest reason for each, are in `docs/OTHER-TVS.md` — along with what we are working on to reach them. **What it will not do:** replace the operating system, unlock a bootloader, or survive a factory reset.
